skill.summary: 中国天气数据抓取工具 - 从 weathercn.com 抓取实时天气数据，支持全国城市。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of weather-fetch

- Fetches real-time weather data from weathercn.com for any city in China
- Outputs temperature, humidity, pressure, visibility, sunrise/sunset times, wind, and AQI
- Uses Playwright for automated data extraction
- Simple command-line usage with city name as input
- Free to use, open source, donations welcome
